case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

You asked for a clear basis for the coming contract term. Our options give Selvbrunn a binding volume over a longer contract term, which is the planning security a pricing committee can work with.

On the cost side, you pointed to copper, labour and the producer price index. Here is where we stand:

Our forecast for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 rises 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

On price history:

Our orders of Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 with you were placed at EUR 414.61 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011548-10), EUR 400.19 on 2025-06-30 (po:4500012634-10), EUR 412.74 on 2026-01-27 (po:4500013491-10) and EUR 412.74 on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014465-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 418.79; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 416.33; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 415.11; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Binding volume in every option: 4,580 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It combines the binding volume and the longer term with a payment term that suits our planning, and the price history shows a base that already carries the product.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since a step of this size may need your pricing committee, here is a paragraph for its decision-maker. Option A gives Selvbrunn a binding volume every year over a full contract term, with no volume risk and no renegotiation during that period. It is a single, clear decision for the committee, and we are ready to supply anything the approval needs. Please take Option A to the person who decides.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We have reviewed your verified price history and volume forecast, which allows us to adjust our position. As to the price history and volume change data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We are willing to accommodate your preferred 24-month contract term and 90-day payment period. In exchange for these extended terms, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 431.63. 

Our current Angebot comprises a price of €431.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. This offer remains valid for 30 days. Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

You said you can talk about payment, volume or contract length instead of price. Our options do exactly that: a binding volume over a longer contract term, which gives your pricing committee the planning security it needs.

On delivery:

Your on-time delivery was 84.6% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70530@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 420.71; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 418.24; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 417.02; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Binding volume in every option: 4,580 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Selvbrunn the longest payment term you asked for together with a binding volume over the full contract term, so your planning is fixed.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

For your pricing committee, in plain words: Option A commits Hollerau to a binding annual volume over the whole contract term, with payment on the term you proposed. It needs no price reduction beyond what the committee can review in one step, and it gives Selvbrunn a secure, plannable customer for the full contract term. Please take Option A to the committee as it stands. If it needs anything further from us to decide, we will provide it.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
